speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with a breast mass; to begin my assessment, have you noticed any changes in the size, shape, or texture of the lump, and is it painful to the touch?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Inflammatory Breast Cancer (or rapidly growing malignancy).

The mass has grown rapidly over four weeks in a 48-year-old woman. I need to know if there are signs of skin involvement, such as dimpling, redness, or warmth, and if you have noticed any changes in lymph nodes in your armpit. Please also confirm if you are experiencing nipple discharge or inversion.
